Close-up from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle just inside the southern doorway of an old ancestral mask chamber. A stationary incense burner filled with pale ash exactly to its rim occupies the left foreground. Immediately to its right, one offering plate holds exactly three fruits: two fresh, full fruits and one visibly shriveled fruit. All three fruits are separately visible, with no overlap hiding the shriveled one. No burning incense. Dark wooden offering racks recede softly into the background; the deepest central compartment is outside the frame. Cool blue nighttime ambient light with a faint warm spill from the southern doorway, sculpted shadows and readable material edges. No people, no text, no subtitles, no watermark.
